jobs.title: Principal Ecological Consultant - Edinburgh / Glasgow
jobs.description:
Edinburgh Biodiversity Permanent

Principal Ecological Consultant (Generalist & Ornithology) – Edinburgh/Glasgow.

Join our ecology team in a senior role combining technical leadership, project delivery, client engagement and mentoring. We’re looking for an experienced ecological generalist with a strong ornithology specialism to help grow our ornithology offering across a diverse project portfolio. We are open to applications from individuals who could be based in either our London, Bristol or Cirencester office.

What You Will Do

Lead and deliver complex ecological projects across infrastructure, renewables, residential and conservation.
Design and deliver ornithological survey programmes, impact assessments and mitigation strategies.
Provide technical leadership and quality assurance across reports and advice.
Act as a trusted advisor to clients through planning and consenting processes.
Support, mentor and develop colleagues within the ecology team.
Help shape best practice and drive the continued development of our ornithology services.

What we’re looking for:

Proven experience delivering ecological consultancy projects, including managing budgets, programmes and stakeholders.
Strong generalist ecological knowledge with a demonstrable ornithology specialism.
Experience designing and delivering bird surveys and translating results into clear, proportionate advice.
Confident report writer with experience supporting planning/consenting (and, where relevant, inquiry/appeal processes).
A collaborative leader with the ability to mentor others and build strong client relationships.

For further details please refer to the attached job description

To find out more on our projects and services in Biodiversity: Biodiversity & Ecology Services | Pegasus Group

What are the benefits to you?

When you join Pegasus Group, you’ll receive an excellent remuneration and benefits package, including:

Agile working
Private Healthcare
Life Insurance
Generous annual leave entitlement with the option to buy and sell holidays
Enhanced Maternity and Paternity pay
Training and Development

Our full benefits can be viewed here
www.pegasusgroup.co.uk/careers/

Why Join Us?

We are a vibrant and dynamic development consultancy that thrives on enhancing the built and natural environment in a way that positively affects people’s lives.

When you join Pegasus you become part of a people-focused business, where your industry knowledge and expertise will help inform critical decisions across local and nationally significant projects. As a proudly independent company since 2003, we have grown to become one of the UK’s leading multidisciplinary development consultancies.

Our commitment to supporting your career goals and ambitions continues throughout your learning and development. With opportunities that enable you to progress to be the very best in our industry!

Diversity, Inclusion and Recognition.

At Pegasus Group, we appreciate diverse minds and unique thinking styles. We believe that every individual brings inimitable ideas and perspectives to enhance our dynamic team. We foster an environment where everyone’s voice is heard and respected, nurturing the growth of our people, communities, and clients. In April 2025 we received accreditation as a 'Great Place to Work,' emphasising the supportive and dynamic work environment we provide.

Pegasus Group is proud to promote equal opportunities and inclusion for all.

To make the recruitment process more accessible and inclusive, we offer flexibility in our application and interview processes. If you require certain accommodations or adjustments, please feel free to let us know so that we can offer you an accessible interview process.

jobs.title: Restoration Contents Technician
jobs.description:
We specialize in mitigating and rebuilding residential and commercial properties damaged by fire, water, storms, and other disasters. We partner with leading insurance carriers and handle everything from emergency cleanup to complete rebuilds, with a focus on safety, integrity, and advocacy. As entrepreneurs, we take full ownership of the work we do and the families we serve.

At Merit, our purpose is simple and non-negotiable: we work together as a team so we can change lives.
Teamwork is the foundation of everything we do—because teamwork creates impact, and impact changes lives. We exist to help people, and the only way we do that at the highest level is by moving as one team, aligned in mission, values, and execution.

Why we exist.
We exist for two families. The families we serve and the families inside this company. When we work together and serve our clients at the highest level, both families win.

The Contents Technician
is responsible for the hands-on packing, cleaning, and restoration of customer contents affected by fire, water, or other covered losses, helping return items to pre-loss condition. This role documents and inventories customer belongings from the moment of pack-out through final return, maintaining accurate photographs, itemized records, and disposition notes throughout the process.

The Contents Technician communicates directly with customers with care and professionalism, inspects completed work for quality, and helps maintain the contents processing facility and equipment. This role supports the broader Contents team by keeping daily logs current and coordinating closely with Project Managers, Supervisors, and Managers to keep every job on track.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Contents Packing & Documentation

Photograph, identify, and inventory customer's contents at the time of pack-out
Wrap, package, and label contents for transport to the cleaning facility
Maintain accurate inventory of all processed contents and their disposition
Complete a daily log of work performed

Cleaning & Restoration

Unwrap, assess, and clean contents according to established procedures
Identify, re-wrap, package, and label cleaned contents for storage or return
Inspect completed work to confirm it meets quality standards
Perform basic maintenance on contents cleaning equipment

Customer Service & Communication

Communicate effectively and professionally with customers throughout the contents process
Return cleaned and restored property to the customer once building restoration is complete
Wait on shop customers as needed

Facility & Shop Maintenance

Vacuum and maintain cleanliness of the shop
Clean the shop bathroom and drying rooms
Wash shop towels and moving blankets
Pull trash and recycling
Provide the Branch Manager with a list of supplies needed

Collaboration & Reporting

Determine the appropriate sequence of steps for cleaning and restoring each customer's contents
Maintain timely and effective communication with Project Managers, Supervisors, and Managers

Requirements

High school diploma or GED
Ability to apply basic math skills to determine appropriate equipment type and quantity needed for a job
Basic proficiency with computers, email, and mobile devices used to record and report daily activity
Familiarity with contents inventory or job-tracking software is a plus, or a fast learner
Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in documentation and quality control
Clear, professional communicator, comfortable interacting with customers in stressful situations
Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
IICRC certification in contents processing or a related discipline is a plus, though not required for this position
Valid driver's license and reliable transportation preferred

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The employee is regularly required to sit, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear, and is frequently required to stand and walk
The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds
Work is carried out both on customer property and within the company's contents processing facility
The employee may encounter properties without utilities or heat, fire damage, or mold and other organic growth, and should follow appropriate safety protocols and use provided personal protective equipment when handling contaminated or hazardous materials
Daily exposure to the contents processing area where inventory, supplies, and equipment are stored and maintained is typical
The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

Benefits

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Life insurance
Vision insurance

jobs.title: Restoration Contents Cleaner
jobs.description:
We specialize in mitigating and rebuilding residential and commercial properties damaged by fire, water, storms, and other disasters. We partner with leading insurance carriers and handle everything from emergency cleanup to complete rebuilds, with a focus on safety, integrity, and advocacy. As entrepreneurs, we take full ownership of the work we do and the families we serve.

At Merit, our purpose is simple and non-negotiable: we work together as a team so we can change lives.
Teamwork is the foundation of everything we do—because teamwork creates impact, and impact changes lives. We exist to help people, and the only way we do that at the highest level is by moving as one team, aligned in mission, values, and execution.

Why we exist.
We exist for two families. The families we serve and the families inside this company. When we work together and serve our clients at the highest level, both families win.

The Contents Cleaner
is responsible for cleaning, deodorizing, and restoring customer belongings once they arrive at the contents processing facility. This role focuses on the hands-on cleaning and restoration process; contents packing, inventorying, and customer pack-out/pack-back responsibilities are handled by the Contents Technician.

The Contents Cleaner uses the appropriate tools, techniques, and cleaning solutions for each item type to restore belongings as close to pre-loss condition as possible, and inspects completed work for quality before it moves on for storage or return. This role supports the broader Contents team by keeping the cleaning area organized and equipment well maintained, and coordinating closely with the Contents Technician and Lead Contents Project Manager to keep work moving efficiently.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Core duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

Cleaning & Restoration

Clean, deodorize, and restore household and personal items using appropriate techniques, tools, and cleaning solutions for each item type
Operate specialized cleaning equipment, such as ultrasonic cleaners, ozone machines, and air scrubbers, as needed
Assess incoming items for damage type and determine the appropriate cleaning or restoration method
Identify items that cannot be fully restored and flag them for review

Quality & Documentation

Inspect completed work to confirm it meets Merit's quality standards before items move on for storage or return
Document the condition of items before and after cleaning as directed
Complete a daily log of work performed

Facility & Equipment Maintenance

Maintain a clean, organized, and safe cleaning area within the contents processing facility
Perform routine maintenance and upkeep on cleaning equipment and tools
Follow proper procedures for the use and storage of cleaning chemicals and supplies

Teamwork & Communication

Communicate and coordinate with the Contents Technician and Lead Contents Project Manager to keep work moving efficiently
Follow daily work assignments and priorities as directed

Requirements

High school diploma or GED
Prior cleaning, housekeeping, or restoration experience preferred; on-the-job training provided
Ability to safely and effectively work with a variety of cleaning chemicals, solutions, and specialized equipment
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
Ability to work efficiently both independently and as part of a team
Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and document work as directed
IICRC certification in contents or textile cleaning is a plus, though not required for this position

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, reach with hands and arms, and talk or hear
The employee must regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds, and occasionally lift and/or move up to 75 pounds
Work is performed primarily within the company's contents processing facility
The employee will be regularly exposed to cleaning chemicals, odors, and items affected by fire, water, smoke, or mold damage, and should follow appropriate safety protocols and use provided personal protective equipment
The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate

Benefits

401(k)
401(k) matching
Dental insurance
Health insurance
Life insurance

jobs.title: Business Development Executive | Environmental Due Diligence & Property Technology
jobs.description:
Business Development Executive

Sydney | Hybrid Working (3 days in office, 2 WFH)

We're recruiting for a growing business operating at the intersection of property, environmental risk, geospatial intelligence and technology. This role offers the opportunity to work with law firms, conveyancers and property professionals, helping them better understand environmental and planning considerations associated with land and property.

You'll be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building long-term client relationships, and driving adoption of innovative solutions that combine property, environmental and location-based intelligence.

The Opportunity

Working across a strategic partnership within the legal and property technology sector, you will help grow awareness, drive product adoption, and build lasting relationships with law firms, conveyancers, property professionals, planners, and consultants.

You will manage opportunities from initial engagement through to onboarding and continued account growth, becoming a trusted advisor to clients on environmental and planning due diligence solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Generate and qualify new business opportunities across legal, property, and professional services sectors.
Build relationships with prospective and existing clients to drive product adoption.
Manage a pipeline of opportunities through CRM systems and maintain accurate sales activity records.
Conduct product demonstrations, training sessions, and client presentations.
Educate clients on environmental, planning, compliance, and due diligence solutions.
Support onboarding and encourage ongoing client engagement and product usage.
Attend industry events, networking functions, webinars, and conferences.
Provide market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitor insights to internal stakeholders.

About You

We welcome applications from professionals with experience in sales, business development, planning, legal, consulting, or compliance-related fields. Whether you are an experienced sales professional or looking to transition into a commercial role, we would love to discuss this unique opportunity with you. Relevant backgrounds include:

SaaS business development or sales
Environmental planning
Environmental law
Property law or conveyancing
Town planning
Environmental consulting
Compliance and regulatory advisory services
Property due diligence and risk advisory

Ideally, You'll Bring

1-4 years' experience in sales, business development, account management, consulting, legal, planning, compliance, or client-facing roles.
Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
Confidence presenting to clients both virtually and in person.
Interest in property, planning, environmental risk, and compliance.
A proactive, self-motivated approach and strong organisational skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholder groups.
Experience using CRM platforms is advantageous.
Full and unrestricted AU working rights.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Join a growing sector focused on environmental, planning, and property risk intelligence.
Learn from experienced commercial and industry professionals.
Develop a career in technology-enabled consulting and solution sales.
Work with clients across legal, property, planning, and environmental markets.
Excellent platform for someone looking to combine technical knowledge with commercial growth and relationship management.

For a confidential discussion, please reach out to:
Kate Faulkner
Senior Client Solutions Manager - Brunel
k.faulkner@brunel.net
0455 667 863

jobs.title: Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Professional Engineer
jobs.description:
Benefits:

401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary
Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Profit sharing
Vision insurance

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.

Business Development Executive

Sydney | Hybrid Working (3 days in office, 2 WFH)

We're recruiting for a growing business operating at the intersection of property, environmental risk, geospatial intelligence and technology. This role offers the opportunity to work with law firms, conveyancers and property professionals, helping them better understand environmental and planning considerations associated with land and property.

You'll be responsible for developing new business opportunities, building long-term client relationships, and driving adoption of innovative solutions that combine property, environmental and location-based intelligence.

The Opportunity

Working across a strategic partnership within the legal and property technology sector, you will help grow awareness, drive product adoption, and build lasting relationships with law firms, conveyancers, property professionals, planners, and consultants.

You will manage opportunities from initial engagement through to onboarding and continued account growth, becoming a trusted advisor to clients on environmental and planning due diligence solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Generate and qualify new business opportunities across legal, property, and professional services sectors.
Build relationships with prospective and existing clients to drive product adoption.
Manage a pipeline of opportunities through CRM systems and maintain accurate sales activity records.
Conduct product demonstrations, training sessions, and client presentations.
Educate clients on environmental, planning, compliance, and due diligence solutions.
Support onboarding and encourage ongoing client engagement and product usage.
Attend industry events, networking functions, webinars, and conferences.
Provide market intelligence, customer feedback, and competitor insights to internal stakeholders.

About You

We welcome applications from professionals with experience in sales, business development, planning, legal, consulting, or compliance-related fields. Whether you are an experienced sales professional or looking to transition into a commercial role, we would love to discuss this unique opportunity with you. Relevant backgrounds include:

SaaS business development or sales
Environmental planning
Environmental law
Property law or conveyancing
Town planning
Environmental consulting
Compliance and regulatory advisory services
Property due diligence and risk advisory

Ideally, You'll Bring

1-4 years' experience in sales, business development, account management, consulting, legal, planning, compliance, or client-facing roles.
Strong relationship-building and communication skills.
Confidence presenting to clients both virtually and in person.
Interest in property, planning, environmental risk, and compliance.
A proactive, self-motivated approach and strong organisational skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholder groups.
Experience using CRM platforms is advantageous.
Full and unrestricted AU working rights.

Why Consider This Opportunity?

Join a growing sector focused on environmental, planning, and property risk intelligence.
Learn from experienced commercial and industry professionals.
Develop a career in technology-enabled consulting and solution sales.
Work with clients across legal, property, planning, and environmental markets.
Excellent platform for someone looking to combine technical knowledge with commercial growth and relationship management.

new_jobs.description:
Benefits:

401(k)
Bonus based on performance
Competitive salary
Dental insurance
Flexible schedule
Health insurance
Paid time off
Parental leave
Profit sharing
Vision insurance

HETI has a great opportunity for a Senior Geologist/Senior Environmental Scientist/Senior Engineer with 10+ years’ experience in the environmental field.

This role will be responsible for providing technical and business skills and contribute to advanced solutions in the environmental, chemical, commercial, manufacturing, government, energy, financial, insurance, and/or legal sectors. This job is 100% remote.

The candidate should have experience managing consulting assignments, must work effectively in multi-disciplinary teams, is expected to be proficient in the analysis and communication of information, and must be able to work cooperatively with agencies, organizations, and individuals to guide decision-making. The successful candidate is also expected to be proficient in all facets of project management. He/she must demonstrate collaboration with colleagues throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Client Management & Communication:

Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and stakeholders, providing regular updates on project status and outcomes.
Collaborate with project teams, including environmental engineers, geologists, and technicians.
Communicate complex technical information to clients and stakeholders in a clear and concise manner.

Regulatory Compliance & Reporting:

Interact and coordinate with regulatory agencies to obtain necessary approvals, permits, and closure documentation.
Prepare and submit comprehensive reports, including site investigation reports, risk assessment reports, remedial action plans, progress reports, and closure reports.
Be current and continue to be current on environmental regulations and guidelines.

Remediation Planning/Implementation:

Develop and implement effective remediation plans based on the findings of site investigations and risk assessments.
Design and oversee the implementation of remediation strategies, which may include excavation, soil vapor extraction, groundwater treatment, in-situ bioremediation, or other appropriate methods.
Ensure compliance with all applicable regulations, guidelines, and permits during the remediation process.

Insurance Claim Support

Experience providing technical support to insurance claims professionals for environmental or energy related claims.
Understanding of insurance terminology and policy language.
Experience in assessing the source and timing of pollution events.
Diverse environmental consulting experience.
Excellent technical writing skills.

Site Assessments:

Manage/conduct comprehensive site investigations to identify potential sources of contamination, evaluate risks, and develop appropriate remediation strategies.
Collect soil, groundwater, and other environmental samples and analyze them in accordance with standard protocols and regulations.
Perform data interpretation, risk assessment, and modeling to determine the extent and nature of contamination and its potential impact on human health and the environment.

Quality Control:

Implement quality control and assurance measures to ensure accurate and reliable data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Conduct periodic audits and reviews of project activities to verify compliance with project plans and regulations.
Identify and address any deviations or discrepancies in project execution promptly.

The Ideal Candidate should have:

Current PE or PG license
Bachelor’s Degree in environmental science, geology, engineering, or a related field.
10+ years’ experience conducting site investigations remediation and third party evaluations
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, guidelines, and best practices related to contaminated site cleanup.
Excellent project management skills, including the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with clients, regulatory agencies, and project teams.
Attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
Knowledge of environmental sampling techniques and laboratory analysis methods.

Founded in 1986, HETI is a full-service, nationwide environmental services company specializing in environmental and indoor air quality site assessment, site remediation, risk characterization, occupational health and safety services, and litigation/expert witness support. Through our network of offices throughout the U.S., we serve a variety of large and small businesses.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and offer a competitive benefit package including base salary plus bonus opportunities and a friendly, flexible work environment.

Flexible work from home options available.
